title: Boli Zainab Mai Aayi Hunn Amma
body:
Boli Zainab mai aayi hunn amma.
Mai bahut dukh uthayii hunn amma.
1. Aaraha tha kaleja munn ko mere. phir bhi waada nibhayii hunn amma.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Karbala se mai raahay zindaan tak.
Taaziyane bhi khaayi hunn amma.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Chhin gayi jab rida mere sar se
Baalon se munn chupaayi hunn amma.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Arbayeen e Hussain ki qaatir.
Karbala jaake aayi hunn amma.
